name: Raptive Intelligence
author: Raptive

sections.description:
Raptive Intelligence facilitates access to the Raptive Assistant on eligible public pages on approved sites.

The Assistant is enabled by default on activation. A site administrator can turn it off in Settings > Raptive Intelligence. When enabled, the plugin loads Raptive’s remote script from Raptive’s production CDN and connects to assistant.production.raptive.ai on eligible public pages. The service sends the page URL to request page tips and receives page context and visitor questions to provide responses.

Use of the Raptive Assistant is governed by the Raptive Service Agreement.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. The Assistant is enabled by default. To turn it off, go to Settings > Raptive Intelligence, clear Enable Raptive Assistant, and save.
sections.changelog:
0.1.17

  • Keep Assistant startup scripts out of Perfmatters delay and defer.

0.1.16

  • Restore site checks so Testing stays manual-only and Disabled stops Assistant startup.

0.1.15

  • Initialize the Ad Code command queue before adding Assistant ad targeting flags.

0.1.14

  • Keep Assistant ad targeting flags queued when Ad Code starts later.
  • Keep ordinary phone and tablet visits with Slickstream. Manual Assistant tests remain available.
  • Allow explicit Assistant tests outside the US and reject duplicate rai parameters.

0.1.13

  • Notify Raptive when public posts and pages are published or updated, with bounded retries that honor the plugin opt-out.

0.1.12

  • Keep Assistant startup scripts out of WP Rocket delay and defer.

0.1.11

  • Include the installed plugin version in WordPress and Assistant events.

0.1.10

  • Enable automatic updates once on new single-site installations, when site policy permits. Owners can turn them off in WordPress. Existing installations keep their update settings.

0.1.9

  • Remember manual Assistant testing across pages. Use rai=false to clear testing.

0.1.8

  • Add creator Save/Unsave hooks with on-page Undo and Favorites links to Cookbook.
  • Enable the Raptive Assistant by default on activation.

0.1.7

  • Update the plugin description and WordPress.org icon.
